create_gaussian_toy_dataset: create a GaussianToyDataset with class weights, sigmas, and dimensionality to simulate ambiguous ground truth
sample_points_dataset: sample points and ground truth labels from the Gaussian mixture toy dataset
evaluate_points_dataset: evaluate probability densities of points under each class in the Gaussian mixture
sample_rankings_dataset: sample human-like partial rankings from ground truth probabilities with reader sharpness
vary_number_of_readers_dataset: vary the number of readers per example by discarding reader entries in partial rankings
